affected_system: walking, cycling, and shared micromobility network
alternatives: protect minimum coverage before needs-based allocation of shared-mobility fleet and charging capacity
adapt allocations using observed demand, uptake, and capacity for shared-mobility fleet and charging capacity
pair minimum-access and demand-responsive fleet allocation with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Trips, counts, facilities, stress levels, barriers, and shared-vehicle states use documented coverage.
Observed shared-system trips do not represent all walking and cycling demand.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: retain the current distribution rule for shared-mobility fleet and charging capacity.

constraints.description: The active mobility network and micromobility allocate must respect declared minimum service, eligibility, capacity, and distributional safeguards.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: active transportation director and shared-mobility program manager
decision_question: How should vehicles, adaptive devices, docks, and charging capacity be distributed?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The active mobility network and micromobility allocate must respect declared minimum service, eligibility, capacity, and distributional safeguards.
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for shared-mobility fleet and charging capacity passes documented checks for eligible denominators, group attributes, inventory, minimum-service rules, and allocation records.
independence_key.primary_outcome: forecast trips without an available suitable vehicle

intended_claim: A versioned allocate design for comparing declared alternatives affecting shared-mobility fleet and charging capacity, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: forecast trips without an available suitable vehicle
distributional gap in forecast trips without an available suitable vehicle
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not report vehicle allocation as availability at use time or completed equitable access.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for shared-mobility fleet and charging capacity passes documented checks for eligible denominators, group attributes, inventory, minimum-service rules, and allocation records.

title: Allocate shared bicycles, devices, and charging capacity
transportability_risks: Topography, climate, street stress, vehicle access, pricing, and safety perceptions vary.
Platform data can exclude private bicycles, pedestrians, and non-users.
